description.tr: Etna Yanardağı, Avrupa'nın en aktif yanardağıdır ve Catania şehrine yakın konumda yer almaktadır.
description.en: Mount Etna is Europe's most active volcano and is located near the city of Catania.
description.de: Der Ätna ist der aktivste Vulkan Europas und liegt in der Nähe der Stadt Catania.

description.tr: Catania Katedrali, şehirdeki en önemli dini yapıdır ve Barok tarzında inşa edilmiştir.
description.en: Catania Cathedral is the most important religious structure in the city and was built in Baroque style.
description.de: Die Kathedrale von Catania ist das wichtigste religiöse Gebäude der Stadt und wurde im Barockstil erbaut.

en: Tour the interior of the cathedral
